[Rating: 3/10] What a gorgeous box cover!  Your trying to fulfill the goals for points as well as get stars on top of your piles. But you need to be lucky as well. If you’re not. Sorry. Too bad, you let everyone else have fun. Next game.  There needs to be more scissor icons to move them around more. I didn’t get a single card with them until the next to last round, but I needed to cover them up. Everyone else had a chance to use them. The gameplay in general didn’t feel balanced or well play tested. They sure put a lot of time into that box art.

[Rating: 4/10] Tile placement, where you try to stack same color numbers and avoid discard tiles, as they become minus points. While game is filler-type and it's fine, I had worst luck whole game and it made me feel miserable most of game.

[Rating: 5/10] Very simple game of drawing cars and placing in your tableau to achieve objectives and score points. The twist is that you can take or place multiple cards if they are all of the same color or all of the same numbers. Plays quickly but a bit too simple for my taste.
